issues: Pages 1, 3, 5, 7 (content pages) are printed rotated 90 degrees on the portrait sheet and were re-rendered upright to read; pages 2, 4, 6 are blank versos. Page 8 contains only the binding/certification stamp ("Прошнуровано и пронумеровано...") with no table rows. Document has no ТР ТС / раздел section-heading rows, so tr_section is null on every row; bold sub-category labels inside row 14 ("Микроклимат на рабочих местах:", "Неионизирующие излучения:", etc.) are indicator sub-groups, not ТР ТС headings, and were folded into the indicator text instead.
